name: github
description: Interact with GitHub repositories. For reading/editing multiple files or making code changes: use clone_to_workspace (downloads whole repo into terminal sandbox in one step), then @terminal for all edits, then push_workspace (pushes all changes in ONE commit via Git Trees API — no per-file loop, no step explosion). For quick single-file reads or single-file writes use read_file/write_file. write_file and create_repo and push_workspace are real destructive actions — only call them when the user has explicitly asked to commit/push/create something.

action.description: Which GitHub operation to perform. PREFER clone_to_workspace + terminal + push_workspace for any task involving reading or editing multiple files — this uses 3 steps total instead of N steps. Use list_files/read_file only for quick one-off lookups of a single file. write_file is for single-file one-shot writes only. push_workspace requires clone_to_workspace to have been called first this session. delete_workspace: remove one cloned repo folder from the sandbox (local copy only; GitHub untouched).

owner.description: Repository owner/organization. Required for: repo_info, commits, issues, list_files, read_file, write_file, clone_to_workspace, push_workspace.

repo.description: Repository name without owner prefix (e.g. 'OADSON_V3' not 'your-github-user/OADSON_V3'). Required for: repo_info, commits, issues, list_files, read_file, write_file, clone_to_workspace, push_workspace.

path.description: File or directory path within the repo. Required for read_file and write_file. Optional for list_files (omit or '' for repo root).

content.description: Full file content to write. Required for write_file.

commit_message.description: Commit message. Required for write_file and push_workspace.

branch.description: Branch name. Optional for write_file and push_workspace — defaults to the repo's default branch.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA to read from / clone from. Optional — defaults to the repo's default branch.

paths.description: For push_workspace only — optional list of specific relative file paths to push. If omitted, pushes ALL non-ignored files in the workspace. Use when you only changed a subset of files.

state.description: Issue state filter for action='issues'. Defaults to 'open'.

private.description: Whether the new repo should be private. Only for create_repo. Defaults to false.

org.description: Organization name for create_repo. Omit to create under the token owner's personal account.
